text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While searching for Mejiro Bright,
who hadn't shown up even though it was time for training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~.
That cloud looks just like a bird~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Are they heading towards
that big cloud over there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there~.
Taking it nice and slow is totally fine~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-sama.
I was just gazing up at the clouds in the sky~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It feels just like watching a fairy tale.
I could stay like this forever~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am truly, deeply sorry...
I only meant to look up at the sky for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A disgrace to the Mejiro name.
I shall engrave this into my heart so it never happens again...
